name: Deep water and light-to-dark water transitions
purpose: Add a complete animated light/dark-water transition family for all existing shoreline directions, plus matching shoreline gradients.

layout.patterns: preserved from the corresponding canonical border mask

properties_policy: Deep/open-water items clone SID 4825; shoreline-gradient items clone SIDs 4644..4654. Preserve DAT/OTB/XML properties and old records; only new contiguous DAT/OTB records and sprites may be appended.
visual_policy: Literal deterministic blend of canonical light-water pixels with the approved dark-water palette. Preserve original rock pixels, alpha, geometry, texture, patterns and animation; use only nine intermediate blend levels. No generated-image pixels are used.
imagegen_concept_role: reference only; excluded from every import PNG
